name: Elena Yakunina
title: Strategic communications and reputation specialist
bio_short: Strategic communications and reputation specialist with more than 20 years' experience. Former communications director at Nestlé, GlaxoSmithKline and Ehrmann AG. Speaker at World Communication Forum Davos. Bilingual English and Russian.
bio: Elena is a strategic communications and reputation specialist with more than 20 years' experience leading communication functions for major multinational companies. She directed communications at Nestlé Russia and Eurasia, where she managed PR strategy across 11 countries and 12 factories, at GlaxoSmithKline and at Ehrmann AG, giving her deep experience in reputation management, media relations, crisis communication, CSR and stakeholder engagement in complex multinational environments. She has also worked at Finsbury, one of the world's leading financial and strategic communications firms.  Elena holds two Master's degrees, in economics and management from the Moscow Academy of Finance and Law, and in journalism from Lomonosov Moscow State University. She studied leadership at London Business School. She is a member of the World Communication Forum Association in Davos, where she has spoken at professional conferences on corporate communications and social responsibility.  At ISOC, Elena delivers corporate communications, reputation management, crisis communication and media relations programmes. Her experience managing communications for global FMCG and pharmaceutical brands gives her direct insight into the pressures of protecting reputation in highly regulated, consumer-facing industries. She understands how to align communications strategy with business objectives and navigate the competing demands of media, regulators, employees and consumers. Elena is based in Cyprus and trains in English and Russian.
